_note: The list of 2026-11-22 (docs/improvements16.txt: the caves' treasures), its plan's phases 10 to 17 (docs/improvements16_plan.md). 945 items writes them on every map of the game ('maps'): each item copied from its 'like' with its own kind, numbers, buff [kind, amount, seconds], picture ('icon': icons16/icon_<icon>.png), tiers ([]: every tier) and weight in the containers' draws (0: only where it is put or made); 'cave': drawn only in a cave (a cave's gear, rings, tomes and scrolls come from these alone); 'repairs': a repair item's armour weight ('light', 'medium': it mends only that). Recipes: [station, [[label, [any of], count], ...]] (station '' the anvil, 'Alchemist', 'Librarian', 'Oven'). 'regions': a region's biomes (its caves' towers') and the items found only in its caves. 'nodes': veins and growths laid in a cave's rooms, their harvest pile's item and count.

items.name: Deepiron Ore
items.looks: A lump of dark ore hacked from a cave's wall: deepiron, found nowhere above ground. Three make an ingot at an anvil.

items.name: Deepiron Ingot
items.looks: A bar of smelted deepiron, darker and harder than any smith's iron.

items.name: Glowcap
items.looks: A pale mushroom that glows faintly in the dark. Brewed, it lets the eyes see without a torch.

items.name: Grave-moss
items.looks: A grey moss that grows on old bones underground. Brewed, it guards against poison and slowly mends.

items.name: Cave Pearl
items.looks: A pearl grown in a cave pool's still water. Merchants pay well for it.

items.name: Bat-wing Leather
items.looks: Thin tough leather from a cave bat's wing. Two make a patch for light armour at an anvil.

items.name: Crawler Chitin
items.looks: A plate of a cave crawler's shell, cut to fit: it mends medium armour.

items.name: Bat-wing Patch
items.looks: Bat-wing leather stitched into a patch: it mends light armour.

items.name: Blind-fish Oil
items.looks: Oil pressed from the blind fish of cave pools: rubbed on a torch or the ankh, it burns twice as long for twenty minutes.

items.name: Giant's Femur
items.looks: The thigh bone of something far larger than a man, older than any kingdom. A smith could make a named weapon of it.

items.name: Wyrm Vertebra
items.looks: A vertebra of a wyrm, hard as stone. A smith could make a named weapon of it.

items.name: Amber with an Insect
items.looks: A drop of amber with an insect held in it since the world was young: a reagent, and a curiosity collectors seek.

items.name: Petrified Wood
items.looks: A branch turned to stone: a reagent, and a curiosity collectors seek.

items.name: Frost Quartz
items.looks: A cold blue quartz from the caves of the frozen lands. Worked with leather at an anvil, it lines gear against the cold.

items.name: Sun-glass
items.looks: A glass the desert's heat made underground. Woven with leather at an anvil, it keeps gear cool.

items.name: Geode Shard (Blue)
items.looks: A blue crystal from a geode of the cold lands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (White)
items.looks: A white crystal from a geode of the mountains' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Red)
items.looks: A red crystal from a geode of the volcanic lands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Yellow)
items.looks: A yellow crystal from a geode of the canyons' and savannahs' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Green)
items.looks: A green crystal from a geode of the forests' and wetlands' caves.

items.name: Geode Shard (Violet)
items.looks: A violet crystal from a geode of the open lands' and coasts' caves.

items.name: Darksight Draught
items.looks: A glowcap brew: for five minutes your eyes see 18 m into the dark without a torch.

items.name: Grave-moss Antivenom
items.looks: A bitter grave-moss tincture: for five minutes poison hurts you far less.

items.name: Slow Mending Draught
items.looks: Grave-moss, glowcap and old amber steeped together: your wounds close slowly for three minutes.

items.name: Frost-quartz Lining
items.looks: Frost quartz worked into leather and sewn into your gear: for half an hour the cold comes on far more slowly.

items.name: Sun-glass Weave
items.looks: Sun-glass threads woven into your gear: for half an hour the heat comes on far more slowly.
